about: PlayStation Plus Extra/Deluxe/Premium subscribers: This title is available in the PlayStation Plus Game Catalogue, and you may redeem it from your PS4 or PS5 console. (Redemption from web/mobile is currently unavailable.)
Torque up! Hat on! Roll, tumble and extend to get over magma, high walls, and myriad other obstacles in this puzzle game.
TorqueL is a unique 2D 'rolling' & 'extend' platformer/action/puzzle game. Including a total of 50 chambers, and 7 basic routes.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
PS Vita: One-time fee for use of downloads on up to 3 activated compatible Portable Console systems.
